name: Chiedza Reasoning
description: How Chiedza AI thinks. These cue words and steps drive public/js/reasoning.js. Edit a list, run npm run test:reasoning, redeploy, and the AI reasons differently. No code needed.

confidenceNotes.low: I am not fully sure I read this the right way, so check my plan against the question. If it is wrong, tell me again and say which operation you think it needs.
confidenceNotes.medium: I made a plan from the words in the question. Check that it matches what is being asked.

wordproblem: Read it slowly and underline the numbers.
Say in your own words what the question is asking.
Choose the operation: the cue words tell you (altogether means add, left means take away, each means multiply, shared means divide).
Do the working one step at a time.
Check: use the opposite operation to see if you get back to where you started.
Write the answer with its unit, in a sentence.
sequence: Write the numbers in a row.
Find the gap between each pair (subtract the first from the second).
If the gaps are the same, add that gap. If not, look at the gaps of the gaps, or try multiplying.
Test your rule on every number you were given.
Use the rule to find the next number.
logic: List every fact you are told. Use ONLY these facts.
Join the facts into a chain, one link at a time.
Check each link is really stated, not just guessed.
If the chain does not connect, the honest answer is: we cannot tell.
cause: Ask 'because of what?' again and again to find the chain of causes.
Check each link in the chain makes sense.
Ask what would change if one link was removed.
compare: Choose the points to compare them on (what, where, how, why).
Say what is the same and what is different.

fallacies.converse: Be careful: 'All {A} are {B}' does NOT mean 'all {B} are {A}'. For example, all dogs are animals, but not all animals are dogs.
fallacies.undistributed: Knowing that some {A} are {B} does not tell us about every {A}.
